Author: penguin4glte
Name: Auto Retainer Sell List
Description: Configure a list of items to maintain on sale at (lowest market price - 1 gil)
Changelog: Fixed an issue where items could still be listed above the lowest market price. Market board listings arrive in batches of 10; the selling price is now calculated from all batches received for the request instead of only the first one. Added a setting "Undercut HQ listings only when selling HQ items" (enabled by default): when selling an HQ item, the price is set to the lowest HQ listing minus 1 gil, ignoring cheaper NQ listings (falls back to the overall lowest if there are no HQ listings). All received listings are now logged at debug level for diagnosis.
